title: KB Knowledge Gap v2
description: Planned migration contract; no current producer or consumer has been migrated to this channel. Source audit of KB's kb.knowledge.gap.v1 call sites found five producer paths: enrich --pass gaps, check --emit-gap, overlap, and watch's scope_divergence and loom.coord claim-overlap handlers. v2 makes that bounded origin taxonomy explicit: enrichment, agent-escalation, overlap, and scope-divergence. entry_id is optional only when the emitting gap is tied to a local vault entry; audited operational and query-rooted producers omit it, including scope-divergence, rather than publishing entry_id: null. Current v1 remains during the producer migration window.

entry_id.description: Optional UUID of the local vault entry that directly triggered the gap. Omit when there is no entry identity; null is not a valid absence representation.

project.description: Project label supplied by the emitting KB command or event.

question.description: Research or coordination question that would resolve the gap.

reasoning.description: Measured coverage, overlap, scope, or enrichment rationale for the gap.

gap_type.description: Bounded origin classification: enrichment = enrich --pass gaps; agent-escalation = check --emit-gap; overlap = overlap or loom.coord claim overlap; scope-divergence = watch scope_divergence.

suggested_deer_query.description: Optional pre-formatted research or coordination query.
